The {wiki:Feral Trapper Outfits|Feral Trapper Outfit} and its two addons are not earned on an adventure: they are bought with **Hunting Task Points** in the Hunting Task Shop of the {wiki:Task Board}. You collect points by completing Weekly Tasks; when you buy the full outfit (170,000 points in total) you get the achievement **Feral Trapper**.
Access to the {wiki:Task Board} to do Weekly Tasks.
Feral Trapper Outfit first and second addons
The points come from the Task Board's **Weekly Tasks**: do the tasks every week to accumulate them faster.
Purchase order and cost: base outfit 100,000, first addon 35,000, second addon 35,000 Hunting Task Points.
Complete Weekly Tasks on the {wiki:Task Board} to earn **Hunting Task Points**. You need 170,000 points for the full outfit.
Once you have **100,000** Hunting Task Points, open the Task Board, go to the **Hunting Task Shop** and buy the base Feral Trapper outfit.
Collect another **35,000** Hunting Task Points and buy the first addon at the Hunting Task Shop.
